rules: No attack variant is introduced by this diagnostic.
All metrics are computed from the exact canonical clean pattern pipeline.
All predeclared metrics must be reported.
No metric may be selected because it is numerically close to the paper's nearly-80-percent statement.
Only canonical_distinct_type_reduction_fraction directly corresponds to the project's current interpretation of distinct-pattern reduction.
Other metrics are semantic diagnostics and must not be silently relabeled as the source statistic.
